title: A Song of Fire and Thunder
desc: I AM FIRE. I AM LIGHTNING. I AM FLAME GIVEN FORM!
buffs: When above 1.25x AP, your melee attacks are imbued in flame, dealing more damage. If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging melee attacks have a chance to inflict scorch (10s CD)
When above 1.2x AP, your kido attacks are inflict thunder, dealing more stun. If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging kido attacks have a chance to inflict electroshock (10s CD)

title: Aura Of Terror
desc: Make them tremble in fear.
buffs: Manual spiritual pressure is replaced with an AOE attack that inflicts a terrifying status effect on enemies hit and deal 3.5% [max HP] damage (50s CD)

title: Adrenaline Junkie
desc: Thrill-seeking taken to the extreme.
buffs: Gain 1% output on hit up to 110% (not including multi hit techniques)
If you do not get hit/hit an enemy for 30 seconds, automatically return to 100%
nerfs: Lose 1% output when getting hit, down to 10%

title: Await the Opening
desc: Be patient, take every advantage.
buffs: Your parries now posture break
nerfs: Your parries are worth 50% as much posture damage

title: Blazing Spirit
desc: An eternal unwavering flame.
buffs: Parrying a basic melee attack ignites your blade with spirit flames (5s CD, +10% damage)
nerfs: Basic melee attacks not ignited by flame deal reduced damage (-2% damage)

title: Ruler's Gaze
desc: The world can not be changed with pretty words alone.
buffs: Performing a manual rushdown activates "Geass"
Whilst "Geass" is active, issue a command to the opponent to halt, allowing for a free follow-up
Enemies affected by "Geass" have their damage taken reduced by 35%, additionally, if blade caught the cooldown will continue as normal
Being in "Aura" ignores the first restriction
nerfs: "Geass" cannot be used on the same target twice, and has a cooldown

title: Quick Grit

buffs: Landing 3 different non-barrage attacks on the same person within 1s smites the opponent, granting a 40% damage buff on the most recent attack (40s CD)

title: Blademaster
desc: An ancient charm, belonging to a blade master.
buffs: Your bladed basic attacks inflict deep gash stacks on your opponent

nerfs: Your bladed basic attacks deal 90% less damage

title: Curtain Call
desc: The final curtain drops.
buffs: As long as your reiatsu is at 100%, your basic attacks have percent lifesteal
nerfs: You no longer passively regenerate reiatsu

buffs: Dealing damage without being hit will build "Perfection", whilst Perfection is building gain up to a 15% damage buff towards enemies, at half stacks or more all damage is fire damage

title: Heavenly Restriction
desc: It is recorded amongst seiretei notes that certain shinigami born thousands of years ago... could never utilize techniques... (Does not fully stack with Warrior's Spirit)

You gain up to 15% more movement speed, and up to 25% more kido defense each scaling with level
Your critical attacks now proc kill confirmed
nerfs: You cannot use abilities to any capacity

title: Haze of Death
desc: You're dead after this.
buffs: Your critical attack applies Cursed status effect for 7s, increasing the damage your opponent takes by 30% (50s CD)

nerfs: Blowing their head off will reduce your output by 5% (Scaling with nearby enemies) temporarily

title: Last Man Standing

buffs: If an ally is to be knocked within 90 meters of you, siphon the enemies HP pack and gain a percent of it yourself
nerfs: Your regeneration from all sources is cut in half

title: Raid Boss

You stop feeling, you stop thinking, you stop being you, there is only the fight, the foe, this man and then the next and the next and the next, and you know they are afraid and tired but you're not, you're alive, and death is all around you but their swords move so slowly, and you can dance through them laughing. [Reworked: Synchronized with Anti-Gank system; PVP-only, does not apply to NPCs].
buffs: For every nearby enemy gain a stack of battle fever, for every nearby ally lose a stack of battle fever, up to 10 stacks
For every stack of battle fever gain a 5% incoming defense, and 3% more damage, both increasing up to 3.5 times
At 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, at 5 stacks your lifesteal doubles at 30%, finally at 7 stacks your m1s periodically proc Perfect Flash
nerfs: When your battle fever is empty and allies are nearby take 10% more damage

title: Shonen Syndrome
desc: Hmph. I'm an avenger.

Upgrades the move by 2 levels (Does not work past level 6)
nerfs: 25 second cooldown between upgrades
